title.en: Puyalile Oru Thoni (புயலிலே ஒரு தோணி) by Pa. Singaram

text.en: A small boat meets a mighty storm at sea.

This is an extract from a novel by Pa. Singaram. When nature turns furious and becomes a dance of destruction, we are helpless. The story shows the great sight of a storm that threatens to roll up a ship at sea, and the struggle of a small boat.
It shows the power of nature and the courage and skill of the sailors. The writer's vivid description makes the storm real to the reader.
Terms: புயல் (storm), தோணி (boat), கடல் (sea) and இயற்கை சீற்றம் (nature's fury).
